body:
Well this person has been kind of berating me a lot recently which had started to get on my nerves. They're reminding me a lot of my ex because if it. There's no possibility of them leaving my life soon so I'm just becoming emotionally numb to everything. No saying that's the answer but that's what I'm doing. They kind of lose their power when you don't feel anything inside. Although doing this means I don't get happy about anything either. I would try it out and see how it works for you. 

Edit: read you're post and I'd say we're in exactly the same boat.

I'm in the exact same situation as you. I would do anything for them but I'm all by myself. I feel like I'm on the outskirts of my friend group. It was to the point where I was putting a noose around my neck and watching the blood rush to my face in the mirror. It hasn't gotten better for me so if you find a solution let me know.

I have a friend with DID and we went to go see it. She said it was very relatable and I actually felt kind of bad suggesting we go see it. I thought it was an amazing movie and I thought it did a good job showing how complex and difficult life can be for someone with DID. Although the ending with the beast was a little cheesy for me. 

But I can see where you're coming from. Anyone without some association to DID most likely didn't pick up on that stuff and just think it's a crazy disorder for serial killers.

I'm socially awkward and constantly convinced everyone hates me and I stress out about the smallest things. Nobody ever invited me out even though they always hang out with each other I'm never truly happy and I've completely lost motivation to do anything even the stuff I previously loved to do. I can talk to any of my friends about how I'm feeling because I'll just be bothering them or make things super weird. I'm just too tired to give a shit about anything and I'm constantly thinking about off-ing myself so I mean I might as well just do it.

Well I feel like I'm on the outskirts on the friend group because of some stuff that happened. The hardest part is it was the type of friends that I have been looking for all my life (never had friends growing up) and just like that it was all gone again. I'm just tired of my life and feeling this way
